notes: On Tallyho's receipts help page; screenshot shows original and converted amounts
integration_notes: Keep the original amount and currency, store the converted amount with the rate and rate date used. Tallyho converts to the user's home currency; in a shared budget the budget's currency must be used for totals (decided in compatibility). Rate provider behind an adapter
description: Receipts in another currency are converted, keeping the original amount

integration_notes: Budget with a limit and currency, members with one owner; every member sees the budget's expenses and spent vs limit. Budget membership is the access boundary for expenses
description: A budget with a spending limit that several people share and all see

notes: Needed to get people into a shared budget; invite flow details unknown
integration_notes: Single-use invitation link sent by email with an expiry; joining requires signing in with the invited email (Tallyho's flow was not seen, so these rules are the design's, to confirm). Email behind an adapter
description: Invite a person to a budget by their email address

notes: Tallyho's expense record: merchant, amount, currency, date, category; listed per budget
integration_notes: Combine with M06: one Expense with Tallyho's merchant, currency and date plus Spendly's integer minor-unit amount, required validated category and optional note
description: Create an expense with merchant, amount, currency, date and category, and list a budget's expenses

notes: Spendly's add(): amount in cents, required category, optional note
integration_notes: Combine with M05 (see there). Spendly's in-memory list is replaced by the database; its rule that amount is integer cents is kept and amounts are additionally validated (> 0)
description: Add an expense in cents with a category and an optional note

notes: Help page plus the user's note that a removed member's expenses stayed in the budget
integration_notes: Tallyho leaves the removed member's expenses in the budget (user-reported) and does not say whether access ends. Keep the expenses (totals stay correct) but end the removed member's access at once and keep the attribution; the owner cannot remove themself
description: The budget owner removes a member

notes: Documented only; what a reset does is unknown
integration_notes: Interpreted as a monthly budget period: spent vs limit counts only expenses dated in the current calendar month (budget's time zone); no expense is deleted. To confirm with the user
description: Each month the budget's spent total starts again

description: Every expense uses one of four fixed categories: food, travel, home, other
